The scores from the two paths, though slightly different (0.5421 vs. 0.534), suggest a consistent level of confidence in the relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Ergocryptine and SQ20B, but further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the specificity and functional significance of this interaction.
